prompt:
Use the provided reference image as the composition and layout guide. Transform the stylized 3D animated character and environment into a hyper-realistic photograph.

Replace the cartoon character with a real human (young adult male, expressive face, large round glasses, styled brown hair), maintaining the same pose (smiling, pointing upward with one finger). Preserve personality and friendliness, but render with natural skin texture, pores, subtle imperfections, and realistic lighting.

Convert the scene into a real-world studio environment: a modern desk setup with practical lighting (warm desk lamp, soft blue ambient light). Materials should look physically accurate (wood grain, fabric hoodie, ceramic mug, paper notebook).

Keep the same composition: desk in foreground, notebook open, mug on the side, shelves and decor in background. Replace all stylized UI elements and icons with real-world equivalents (e.g., monitor screen, printed posters, practical props).

Lighting should be cinematic and photographic: soft key light, realistic shadows, subtle depth of field (50mm lens look, shallow DOF), slight bokeh in background.

Color grading: natural tones, slightly warm highlights, realistic contrast — no neon/cartoon glow.

Style: ultra-realistic, DSLR photo, 8k detail, sharp focus on subject, photoreal skin, global illumination, natural reflections, physically accurate materials

Avoid: cartoon look, plastic skin, exaggerated proportions, overly saturated colors, CGI feel.
